name: [CernoIA PROD] WF-007 - Gestión de errores y recuperación

parameters.query:
WITH run_upsert AS (
    INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs
    (
        workflow_code,
        source_code,
        n8n_execution_id,
        trigger_type,
        status,

        started_at,
        finished_at,

        completion_reason,

        error_node,
        error_message,
        error_details,

        metadata,

        created_at,
        updated_at
    )

    VALUES
    (
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $1::TEXT,
                ''
            ),
            'UNKNOWN'
        ),

        NULLIF(
            $2::TEXT,
            ''
        ),

        $3::TEXT,

        NULLIF(
            $4::TEXT,
            ''
        ),

        'failed',

        NOW(),
        NOW(),

        'workflow_error',

        NULLIF(
            $5::TEXT,
            ''
        ),

        NULLIF(
            $6::TEXT,
            ''
        ),

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $7::TEXT,
                ''
            ),
            '{}'
        )::JSONB,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $8::TEXT,
                ''
            ),
            '{}'
        )::JSONB,

        NOW(),
        NOW()
    )

    ON CONFLICT
    (
        n8n_execution_id
    )

    DO UPDATE

    SET
        workflow_code =
            EXCLUDED.workflow_code,

        source_code =
            EXCLUDED.source_code,

        trigger_type =
            COALESCE(
                EXCLUDED.trigger_type,
                ops.workflow_runs.trigger_type
            ),

        status =
            'failed',

        finished_at =
            NOW(),

        completion_reason =
            'workflow_error',

        error_node =
            EXCLUDED.error_node,

        error_message =
            EXCLUDED.error_message,

        error_details =
            EXCLUDED.error_details,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                ops.workflow_runs.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            EXCLUDED.metadata,

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    RETURNING
        id,
        workflow_code,
        source_code,
        n8n_execution_id,
        trigger_type,
        status,

        started_at,
        finished_at,

        completion_reason,

        error_node,
        error_message,

        batches_processed,
        records_read,
        records_written,

        cursor_start_timestamp,
        cursor_start_process_id,

        cursor_end_timestamp,
        cursor_end_process_id,

        metadata
),

cursor_release AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        status =
            'error',

        error_message =
            NULLIF(
                $6::TEXT,
                ''
            ),

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    cursor.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )

                - 'current_execution_id'
                - 'current_execution_batches'
                - 'current_execution_records'
                - 'current_execution_started_at'

                - 'active_workflow'
                - 'active_execution_id'
                - 'active_execution_started_at'
            )

            ||

            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    $10::TEXT,
                    ''
                ),
                '{}'
            )::JSONB,

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          NULLIF(
              $2::TEXT,
              ''
          )

      AND
      (
          /*
           * Ejecución original reportada por n8n.
           */
          cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
              NULLIF(
                  $9::TEXT,
                  ''
              )

          OR

          /*
           * Ejecución efectiva/fallback manejada por WF-007.
           */
          cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
              $3::TEXT

          OR

          /*
           * Compatibilidad con workflows anteriores.
           */
          cursor.metadata
              ->> 'current_execution_id'
              =
              $3::TEXT

          OR

          /*
           * Compatibilidad con WF-012 / WF-017.
           */
          cursor.metadata
              ->> 'active_execution_id'
              =
              $3::TEXT

          OR

          cursor.metadata
              ->> 'active_execution_id'
              =
              NULLIF(
                  $9::TEXT,
                  ''
              )
      )

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,

        cursor.cursor_timestamp,
        cursor.cursor_process_id,

        cursor.status,

        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,

        cursor.error_message,
        cursor.metadata,
        cursor.updated_at
)

SELECT
    run_upsert.id
        AS workflow_run_id,

    run_upsert.workflow_code,
    run_upsert.source_code,
    run_upsert.n8n_execution_id,
    run_upsert.trigger_type,

    run_upsert.status
        AS workflow_run_status,

    run_upsert.started_at,
    run_upsert.finished_at,

    run_upsert.completion_reason,

    run_upsert.error_node,
    run_upsert.error_message,

    run_upsert.batches_processed,
    run_upsert.records_read,
    run_upsert.records_written,

    run_upsert.cursor_start_timestamp,
    run_upsert.cursor_start_process_id,

    run_upsert.cursor_end_timestamp,
    run_upsert.cursor_end_process_id,

    cursor_release.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor_release.active_execution_id,

    cursor_release.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor_release.lock_expires_at,

    cursor_release.cursor_timestamp,
    cursor_release.cursor_process_id,

    cursor_release.updated_at
        AS cursor_updated_at

FROM run_upsert

LEFT JOIN cursor_release
    ON TRUE;
